content: Ŋgeu eez, iza Yona. Ye Amitai natu. Sawa eez, Yoova aliŋa ila pani ighaze:
ve uvotia aliŋag padi. Usaav padi ughaze: Ŋgar todi samsamia, you Yoova naghita di tisob wa. Tovenen you pale naghur atia padi pa sosor todi.”

Eemoghon Yona itaaru, ve lolo pa ila Ninive maau. Tovenen ighaze iyooŋ pa Yoova, ve ighau ila pa ndug mala eez iza Tarsis. Ye ilaagh izila naari le ila peria ndug Yoppa. Ghoro ighita waaŋ eez to ighaze ila pa ndug Tarsis.
Ye ighol waaŋ atia le isob, ghoro iza waaŋ tonowen, leso ighau pa Yoova ve ila. Mbo 139:7
Tiraav tila, ve Yoova igham yaghur tiina imundig le ipei dibom iza toman tapiri. Ve rismoghon tone timbiriis.

Tovenen matughezaaŋ tiina igham uraata to waaŋ, ve yes eŋaeŋa titaŋ roran maaron todi todi, leso tiuul di. Eemoghon te isami le isami kat. Tauto tipiyaav mburuguuŋ tisob tila pa te, leso waaŋ pokia iza. Yona ikankaan pa pataŋani to ivot. Pasa, izila waaŋ lolo to sila we, ve izi igheen le lolo imaagh kat.

Tovenen ŋgeu to igham pooz pa waaŋ izila toni, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Wai, ukaria ghenooŋ wa! Umundig ve anam utoov utaŋ roran maaron tiom ve taghita! Pale irau iuul ghiit, ma maau. Pasa, paam talaleed.”

Ghoro yes uraata to waaŋ tiwasavon di tighaze: “Ai! Iit irau taŋgozŋgooz, leso taghita sei kat to inim pughu pa pataŋani tonene!” Tovenen tiŋgozŋgooz le ŋgozŋgozaaŋ todi ipatooŋ Yona ighaze ye to inim pughu pa pataŋani tonenen.
Tovenen tighasoni tighaze: “Usaav ghazooŋa payei lak! Pughu vena to pataŋani tonene ivot pait? Ve yom ulaagh pa sa uraat? Yom to sa ndug. Uneep sine to unum?”

Tovenen Yona ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “You to Hibru. Nambesmbees pa Yoova. Ye Maaron to sambam to ighur te ve taan. Eemoghon naghau pani ve nanim.” Tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, le matughezaaŋ tiina igham di. Tovenen tisaav pani tighaze: “Wai, yom ugham sosor tiina kat!
Pale nigham vena payom, leso te imaat, ve taun izi pait?” Pasa, te isami le isami kat.
Yona ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Asur ghou ve apiyaav ghou nazila pa te. Leso taun izi. Pasa, nene sosor tiou, tauto pataŋani tonene ivot.”
Yes uraata to waaŋ lolodi pa tipiyaava izila pa te rikia maau. Tighaze ineep ve titoov ŋgoraaŋ tilooŋ tila pa taan. Tiŋgoor tiŋgoor, eemoghon tiraua maau. Pasa, ndug isami le isami kat.

Tovenen tighaze tipiyaav Yona izila pa te. Eemoghon timatughez pa tigham tovene. Tauto titaŋ roran Yoova tighaze: “O Yoova, ighaze nipiyaav ŋgeu tonene izila te ve imaat, uwaghamun ghei nimaat malep. Ughita ghei ughaze yei nigham sosor malep. Pasa, yei lolomai pa nirab ŋgeu tonene maau. Yom to ugham mbeb tonene ivot itaghon taum lolom ve ŋgar tiom.”
Ghoro tisur Yona ve tipiyaava izila pa te, ve rikia moghon yaghur toman dibom ate izi, ve taun izi.
Yes uraata to waaŋ tighita mbeb tonenen, le timatughez kat pa Yoova. Ve tigham watooŋrau pani, toman saveeŋ mbuaaŋ ariaŋa pida paam.
Ghoro Yoova imbaaŋ iigh tiina eez ila ve itoon Yona. Tovenen Yona ineep ila iigh apo lolo irau mboŋ tol. Mt 12:40, 16:4

footnotes.text: Ninive, nene ndug tiina to yes Asiria. Ineep mala kat pa Israel dige ila pa ndag iza. Yes Israela lolodi pa yes Asiria rita maau, ve timatughez padi. Pasa, yes Asiria tiraua kat pa ghamuuŋ malmal.
Ndug Tarsis ineep mala kat pa Israel dige ila pa ndag izila, ve ndug Ninive ineep ila pa ndag iza. Tovenen tipargharau maau. Tineep saguan saguan kat.
